_comment: Page ranges to ingest per PDF source (1-based PDF page numbers, same as the printed page numbers in both catalogs). Only pages about meeting rooms / conference rooms / hybrid collaboration spaces. Chosen by the ingest agent on 2026-11-10 from the extracted per-page text; `why` is for the human reviewer and is not copied into records. `stage` / `industry` override the source values for that range. Never ingest a whole catalog.
